title: Aera Air
short: A quieter, clearer air purifier for small living spaces.
intro: A compact air purifier concept shaped around the moments between cooking, resting and working at home.
hero: A soft-volume appliance with a calm footprint and a single readable control.

sections.title: The machine should recede, not disappear.
sections.body: Aera Air started with a simple observation: air quality products are often visually loud, while the moments they support are quiet. The design direction focused on presence without visual noise.

sections.title: One continuous surface, three useful states.
sections.body: The body, intake and interface were explored as one family. A soft vertical proportion leaves enough area for airflow while keeping the product easy to place beside a desk, bed or sofa.

sections.title: A product that reads in one glance.
sections.body: The final direction uses a single tactile dial, a replaceable front filter and a restrained finish system. It is intentionally legible before it becomes interactive.
